jyutping: gaau2 dou3 A hou2 hoi1 sam1

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial way to say that something cheers someone up or makes them happy.

examples.english: That joke you told can exhilarate me.
examples.traditional: 聽完你講嗰個笑話，搞到我好開心。
examples.jyutping: teng1 jyun4 nei5 gong2 go2 go3 siu3 waa2 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 hoi1 sam1
